design.burden_basis: original worry sum (0..12) and combined affected-domain count (0..7)
design.country_basis: within-country survey-weighted frozen global B or E proportions; never local cluster IDs
design.country_clustering: average linkage; descriptive cuts 2..8; largest silhouette selects an illustrative cut only
design.distance: Hellinger = Euclidean distance of square-root proportions / sqrt(2)
design.geography: unchanged dataset GlobalRegion and approximate great-circle map-label-point distances
design.holdout_use: post-validation descriptive extension, not untouched confirmation or model selection
design.inference: effect sizes only; no independent-pair p-values, no causal claims, no geographic regrouping
design.tie_break: smaller k on equal silhouette; country ISO order for nearest-neighbour ties
design.uncertainty: 200 IID respondent bootstraps within each country; retain WGT and frozen labels; conditional sensitivity only
